product: Data Classification now scans Unity Catalog views (Beta)
tagline: Data Classification can now scan Unity Catalog views in addition to tables, classifying columns for sensitive data using the same detection engine.
what_it_does: Data Classification can now scan Unity Catalog views in addition to tables, classifying columns for sensitive data using the same detection engine. This is a Beta feature. This page describes how to use Databricks Data Classification in Unity Catalog to automatically classify and tag sensitive data in your catalog.
why_it_matters: It is critical for data teams to understand what kind of sensitive data exists in each table so that they can both govern and democratize access to this data.
